blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. had previously told off former Speaker Martin Romualdez for allegedly taking a portion of funds intended for big-ticket projects, Navotas Rep. Toby Tiangco testified before the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Tuesday. During the continuation of Romualdez’s bail hearing for his plunder case, Tiangco said he had met with President Marcos and the former Speaker at Bahay Pangulo on Nov. 24, 2024, where the President “raised concerns about funding that had been removed from the budget.” In his judicial affidavit, portions of which were read aloud by defense lawyer Thea Daep, Tiangco said the President […]...
